title: Protecting P-Trap Seals Against Siphonage
description: A P-trap maintains a standing water seal that prevents foul sewer gases from entering living spaces. A common issue is trap seal loss, which frequently happens when a fixture lacks adequate venting or suffers from self-siphonage due to unvented configurations like S-traps. When water rushes down an unvented pipe, it creates a negative pressure vacuum that pulls the protective water seal right out of the trap. Installing a properly vented P-trap ensures atmospheric air enters the system to equalize pressure, leaving the water barrier intact. Always verify proper vent distance to keep the trap seal secure.

Protecting P-Trap Seals Against Siphonage

A P-trap maintains a standing water seal that prevents foul sewer gases from entering living spaces. A common issue is trap seal loss, which frequently happens when a fixture lacks adequate venting or suffers from self-siphonage due to unvented configurations like S-traps. When water rushes down an unvented pipe, it creates a negative pressure vacuum that pulls the protective water seal right out of the trap. Installing a properly vented P-trap ensures atmospheric air enters the system to equalize pressure, leaving the water barrier intact. Always verify proper vent distance to keep the trap seal secure.
